measurement.finding: GPU-102 narrows the GPU-101 front-half envelope without changing production. For the frozen case, direct existing-owner calls attributable to same-plane signature construction, edge wire materialization and retained relation hashing account for about 49.23% of profiled compiler cumulative time, versus about 7.77% for direct fact aggregation and about 3.70% for selected block reconstruction. Per-edge retained relation hashing is the largest individually observed direct bucket. This justifies auditing the authority-safe relation-digest seam before proposing any delta API, while the 39.30% remaining residual prevents overclaiming that digest work is the whole bottleneck.
